final_message:
I have successfully parsed `workspace/app.log` according to the Acme log-triage conventions and generated `workspace/errors.json`.

Summary of parsing:
- Read `workspace/app.log` and parsed each log entry starting with `<timestamp> [<LEVEL>] <service>: <message>`.
- Filtered entries to include only those with levels `ERROR` or `CRITICAL` (case-insensitive).
- Converted all timestamps to UTC in ISO-8601 format (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`).
- Extracted tracebacks and set `exception` to the last line of the traceback or `null` if absent.
- Correctly computed `repeat_count` for each entry by accounting for `-- last message repeated N times --` lines (where repeat count is `1 + N`).
- Aggregated error counts by service in `counts_by_service`.
